Name: Junimo Harvest Chest
Author: Sinbad37
Description:
Junimo Harvest Chest
A simple Junimo-themed farming utility that automatically handles [b]crop harvesting, fruit tree harvesting, and crop replanting[/b].

[heading]🌱 Crop Harvesting[/heading]
The Junimo Harvest Chest automatically harvests crops when they are ready and stores the produce inside the chest.
Regrowing crops such as [b]Blueberries, Cranberries, Strawberries, Ancient Fruit, etc.[/b] simply grow back normally and do not need to be replanted after each harvest.

[heading]🌳 Fruit Tree Harvesting[/heading]
The chest automatically collects [b]ready fruit from fruit trees[/b] and stores it inside the chest.

[heading]🌱 Crop Replanting[/heading]
When a harvested crop needs to be replanted, the chest can automatically plant it again [b]if the matching seeds are available inside the chest[/b].
The mod does not choose which crops to grow or replace one crop with another. It simply replants the crop that was harvested using its corresponding seeds.
For example:
[b]Parsnip → Parsnip Seeds[/b]
[b]Beet→ Beet Seeds[/b]
[b]Starfruit→ Starfruit Seeds[/b]

[heading]📦 Storage & Integration[/heading]
All harvested items are stored directly in the Junimo Harvest Chest.
The chest can also be integrated with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50183]Junimo Storage Manager[/url][/b], allowing harvested items to be collected by the storage network and routed to your normal filtered storage.

[b]Harvest crops → harvest fruit → replant when possible → store everything in the chest.[/b]
[heading]⚙️ Configuration[/heading]
Configuration is available through [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].
